summary: Genuine Grade 2 psychologist ads near Eltham are thin today, and the Eastern Health Lilydale role is the one clear match. The rest are casual, fixed-term or narrow specialties, and closing dates could not be confirmed on most ads, so check each employer's page before applying.
criteria: Grade 2 roles within 25 km of Eltham VIC 3095
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist, MPsych (Clinical), MAPS, MACPA
15+ years across community mental health, acute inpatient and complex care
2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader supervising staff
Clinical Psychologist, private allied health (Mill Park), since 2023
Risk assessment, complex case formulation, individual and group therapy, MDT work, supervision
CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, mindfulness-based, trauma-informed
Anxiety, depression, OCD, emotional dysregulation, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness
Eltham; north and north-east are easy commutes, west and south-east are long

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist – Grade 2 or 3 (psycho-oncology)
jobs.why: The grade fits and the work covers clinical and health psychology, mainly the Familial Cancer Centre and Breast Oncology. The specialty is new to her and it was only seen in an August 2026 SEEK snapshot, so it may not still be open.

jobs.title: Mental Health Clinician – Community
jobs.grade: Grade 2 Psychologist eligible (earlier PD: SW2, P2, OT2, RPN3)
jobs.why: Community case management for serious and complex mental illness, which fits her Neami and community mental health background. The PD is from an earlier ad and may not match this one.

jobs.title: Youth Mental Health Clinician (SW2, OT2, P2, RPN3)
jobs.location: Northern Mental Health (exact site not shown; Epping, Preston or Mill Park possible)
jobs.why: Public youth community mental health role that includes P2. It is a generalist case-manager position and may no longer be open.

jobs.title: Perinatal Mental Health Psychologist
jobs.why: Public mental health psychologist role in an easy commute area. The grade and closing date could not be confirmed.

jobs.title: Psychologist, Grade 2 or 3 (Eating Disorders)
jobs.why: Eating disorders is a specialty she hasn't worked in, and it is a contract role with an unconfirmed closing date.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist
jobs.why: Permanent mental health role. A Glassdoor listing shows a Grade 2 Clinical Psychologist at Box Hill, which may be the same role, but the grade and closing date are unconfirmed.

jobs.title: Clinical or Health Psychologist – Grade 2 – Community Therapy Service
jobs.work_type: Ongoing, part time, 16 hours per fortnight, hybrid
jobs.why: Grade 2 and in range, but very part-time and focused on rehabilitation psychology in a community outpatient setting. Couldn't confirm it is still open.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist – Pain Service
jobs.why: Close to home and suits her complex and chronic health experience. The listing asks for 5+ years' experience, which may mean Grade 3, and no grade or closing date was shown.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Psychologist, parental leave cover (Yarra Ranges Mental Health and Wellbeing Local)
jobs.work_type: Contract (max term), part time 0.6 EFT (posted 16 Jul 2026)
jobs.source: Ethical Jobs and Access Health careers
jobs.why: Good fit, but it is fixed-term and only 0.6 EFT. It is also the same consortium as the Eastern Health role.

jobs.title: Paediatric Registered Psychologist, Grade 2
jobs.why: The ad asks for paediatric, developmental disability and early intervention experience, which she has not done.

jobs.title: Clinical or Health Psychologist – Grade 2
jobs.location: Site not confirmed (Epping or Bundoora in range, Craigieburn not)
jobs.why: Covers acute, subacute, community and outpatient settings in an MDT, which fits well. The site and closing date are unconfirmed, and the older 'CTS and HARP' version of this ad is from a previous year.

jobs.title: Mental Health Clinician (SW2, OT2, P2, RPN3)
jobs.location: Northern Mental Health (exact site not shown; Epping, Preston or Mill Park possible)
jobs.why: Public community mental health role that includes P2 and matches her background. It is a generalist case-manager position and may no longer be open.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Clinical Psychologist (casual, psychosocial oncology)
jobs.why: Pay and grade fit, but it is casual only and a psycho-oncology specialty. Two similar Peter Mac ads appear to be the same role.

jobs.title: Paediatric Registered Psychologist Grade 2
jobs.why: Probably closed (posted 2 Jul 2026) and a paediatric role, which is outside her experience.

jobs.why: The role is open to Grade 2 psychologists, as well as Grade 3 RPNs, OTs and social workers. It is case management rather than a pure therapy role. The employer's own ad could not be found, so it is unverified.

jobs.title: Grade 2 Clinical or Health Psychologist – Casual
jobs.why: Fits her grade and covers hospital medical and mental health assessment and therapy. It is casual with no guaranteed hours and has been listed since at least May, so it may be a rolling pool.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist Grade 2 or Grade 3 (part-time)
jobs.why: Not verified. Close to home, but it only appears in a July SEEK snapshot and is worth a manual look.

jobs.why: Not verified. Community mental health fits her background, but it needs a manual check for whether it is current. Distance is a rough estimate.

jobs.why: Casual oncology role with the site unconfirmed. The Careers Vic ad is dated February 2026, but an August 2026 SEEK listing shows Peter Mac still seeking a Grade 2 for a flexible casual role.

jobs.title: Casual Grade 2 Psychologist
jobs.why: Assessment and therapy across hospital medical and mental health services. Casual only with no guaranteed hours, and RMH advertises allied health vacancies internally first. The SEEK listing was about 12 days old, and the RMH ad itself wasn't visible.
